text:
alex_support: customer reporting 429s even though Console shows available quota for their token. customer provided request_id=rc-9f3a and example curl.
jamie_sre: can you paste the exact curl + X-Request-ID header? also which region/tenant?
alex_support: tenant=acme-inc, region=us-west-2. curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer tok_acme\" -H \"X-Request-ID: rc-9f3a\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}'`
maria_eng: quick hypothesis: enforcement decisions come from rate-enforcer which reads windows from aggregator topic. Console reads the metering snapshot DB. they can be out of sync if aggregator replay lags. any recent deploys to enforcer/aggregator?
kevin_prod: we rolled a small change to aggregator 30m ago to improve dedupe; no enforcer deploys. metrics look green in k8s but Kafka consumer lag spiked for ~5m around 22:10 UTC.
jamie_sre: can we fetch the enforcer trace for that request_id? enforcer logs include decision reason.
alex_support: pasted enforcer log (excerpt):
```
2026-02-23T22:11:05Z enforcer[pid=23] request_id=rc-9f3a tenant=acme decision=throttle reason=window_exceeded key=tenant:acme:2026-02-23T22:00:00Z count=101 limit=100
```

maria_eng: interesting — enforcer thinks tenant already exceeded current rolling window. console snapshot query at same minute shows 45 used. so enforcer is higher. implies missing ingested deltas in snapshot writer or a double-counting on enforcer.
kevin_prod: pulling metering-stream logs now. consumer lag timeline: 22:09 -> 22:14 lag 120k msgs, then caught up. looks like a short downtime on the snapshot-writer pod causing a backlog.
jamie_sre: could backlog cause enforcer to apply updates from Kinesis/stream twice during replay? any replay logic that might dup messages?
maria_eng: aggregator uses at-least-once semantics; we dedupe via event_id but dedupe cache TTL is 5m. if replay occurs after TTL, duplicates could be applied. recent change reduced dedupe TTL inadvertently in config.
kevin_prod: config diff shows dedupe_ttl was 300s -> 60s in the last release. that fits.
jamie_sre: ok that explains elevated counts in enforcer. why doesn't Console show same counts? snapshot-writer resumed and wrote compacted aggregates after catch-up; the Console reads compacted state which folded duplicates, while enforcer applied raw deltas and kept them in memory.
alex_support: customer wants mitigation — they're getting 429s in prod. can we hotfix?
maria_eng: short-term: increase dedupe_ttl back to 300s and restart aggregator consumer to avoid replay window hitting TTL. also add a quick fix to enforcer to ignore deltas with identical event_id seen within 10m.
kevin_prod: i'll open a rollback PR for the config change and schedule a restart now.
jamie_sre: can we also add a temporary rule in rate-enforcer to be permissive for tenants with sudden delta spikes (e.g., treat counts > snapshot*2 as suspect)? we should be careful with safety.
maria_eng: yes, a soft-fail mode for a 10m window for affected tenants — log and allow with alert. i'll draft a tiny patch.
alex_support: sent customer a note: "we're investigating, temporary mitigation in progress, will follow up in 30m" :thumbsup:
lloydbot: incident created: INC-2026-1045 assigned to eng-infra, severity=P2.
kevin_prod: rollback PR created: #9876. will deploy to aggregator-staging then prod. ETA 15m.
maria_eng: patch for enforcer dedupe guard is up in review (#9877). also adding debug flag to emit `enforcer_event_id_seen=true` on decisions.
jamie_sre: after deploy, lets run a replay smoke test: publish 200 synthetic events with same event_ids to topic and verify console snapshots and enforcer counters match. document steps so support can repro.
alex_support: customer asked for repro steps so they can verify once we fix. can we provide minimal curl + header to reproduce?
maria_eng: reproduction outline:
1) create tenant test-dup via admin API
2) send N requests with header `X-Event-ID: e-<n>` to ingestion endpoint while pausing snapshot-writer (kubectl scale deployment snapshot-writer --replicas=0)
3) resume snapshot-writer to force replay. observe both enforcer logs and console counts.

example:```bash
for i in {1..120}; do
  curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer tok_test\" -H \"X-Event-ID: e-$i\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -d '{\"input\":\"x\"}' &
done
```

jamie_sre: good. i'll run the smoke test after deploy. we should also add a monitoring alert for Kafka consumer lag and dedupe_ttl drift (config drift detection).
kevin_prod: prod rollback deployed at 22:38 UTC. aggregator dedupe_ttl restored to 300s. restarting enforcer and snapshot-writer now.
lloydbot: rollout success: aggregator v3.4.1 -> success. enforcer patch deployed to canary.
maria_eng: canary looks fine. running the synthetic replay test now. console vs enforcer counts match within tolerance.
alex_support: customer confirmed 429s cleared after 22:45. they sent gratitude.
jamie_sre: root cause summary (for postmortem): dedupe TTL reduced in aggregator config caused at-least-once message replay to double-count in enforcer memory window during a short consumer lag; console later compacted aggregates, creating a visibility mismatch and customer-facing 429s. action items: revert config (done), add enforcer dedupe guard, add replay smoke test + doc, add alert for consumer lag and config drift, update runbook.
kevin_prod: creating follow-up ticket and scheduling postmortem.
mar ia_eng: I'll owner the fix PRs and the runbook updates.
alex_support: thanks team — closing thread after postmortem.
